messages:
Marta: Heads up — HelixGrid is asking for Net-180 on a 3yr commit and wants an annual invoicing schedule with a split (Year1 30% upfront, remainder invoiced net180). They also want a short POC before full contract. Need finance/legal guidance, cc @lena_revops @ryan_deals :eyes:
Jude: For the POC we can provision a 2-week dedicated pool. Need their SSO metadata + will they share a sanitized test dataset? Any IP retention requirements?
Priya: CISO asked for SOC2, encryption at rest, KMS + audit logs. I sent them the security questionnaire v2 this morning. Waiting on their responses. :email:
Ryan: Rate-card note — our standard is net30. For Net180 we typically require either a 1) commit uplift or 2) surcharge. Example: for a $3M/yr 3yr deal we could offer 2% off if they do annual upfront OR accept a 5% surcharge for extended terms w/ no upfront. We should decide on which path, and Deal Desk needs to OK.
Lena: Credit/collections note — Net180 beyond 120 days requires a completed credit check + AP contact + signed payment terms in the SOW. Finance will request a credit hold if any signals. I'll open a Deal Desk ticket; Controller needs to review.
Marta: Question — can we allow Net180 for the pilot billing or only for the post-production contract? Buyer expects pilot invoice on POC start.
Ryan: Pilot = short & low risk; we do not usually give Net terms for pilots. Pilot should be prepaid or charged to a card on file. For full contract we can escalate Net180 but probably need a letter of credit or escrow if finance isn't comfortable.
Jude: POC billing recommendations — separate small invoice line for reserved capacity. Draft snippet: ```invoice_schedule:
- pilot: prepaid $20,000
- contract_year_1: 30% upfront, remainder invoiced annual net180
- contract_year_2_3: annual invoices, net180```
Lena: Approvals required: RevOps + Controller + Head of Sales (cc @sofia_headsales). I'll attach the credit report + proposed payment schedule to the Deal Desk ticket. Expected turnaround ~72h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Priya: Data update — buyer okayed staging dataset and wants a DPA before any data exchange. Legal estimates ~30 days review.
finance-bot: New Deal Desk request created: DD-2026-847. Assigned to lena_revops. SLA: 72 hours. Link: https://redwood.internal/deals/DD-2026-847
Marta: Thanks all — I'll tell the buyer pilot must be prepaid and flag potential LOE on legal. Please keep updates here, and tag me if any blocker. :thumbsup:
